papers.title: Efficacy and safety of regorafenib plus PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors for metastatic colorectal cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Zhong Y, Li X, Chen S, Deng M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Regorafenib is an approved later-line therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Combining regorafenib with PD-1/PD-L1 blockade may enhance antitumor immunity by modifying the tumor microenvironment. This meta-analysis compared the combination with regorafenib monotherapy and explored preliminary treatment signals in microsatellite-stable/proficient mismatch repair (MSS/pMMR) mCRC.
METHODS: A comprehensive search was performed in PubMed, Cochrane Library, Embase, Web of Science, and Chinese databases (Wanfang, VIP, CNKI, CBM) up to February 20, 2026. RCTs and RCSs comparing combination therapy with monotherapy were included. Outcomes were ORR, DCR, PFS, and OS, etc. Study quality was assessed using the Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) for observational studies. Analyses were performed using RevMan 5.4, with RR/HR and 95% CIs. Heterogeneity was assessed using I², publication bias via funnel plots, and Egger's/Begg's tests when applicable. Evidence certainty was graded using GRADE.
RESULTS: Eight studies (two RCTs and six RCSs; 992 patients) were included. Compared with regorafenib monotherapy, combination therapy improved ORR (RR = 1.81, 95% CI: 1.15-2.85), DCR (RR = 1.34, 95% CI: 1.10-1.62), and PR (RR = 1.66, 95% CI: 1.07-2.59), and reduced the proportion of patients with PD at tumor assessment (RR = 0.65, 95% CI: 0.50-0.86). Combination therapy was also associated with longer PFS (HR = 0.57, 95% CI: 0.37-0.87), whereas the OS estimate was borderline and did not establish a robust survival benefit (HR = 0.73, 95% CI: 0.54-1.00; P = 0.05). Post hoc exploratory analyses based on extractable MSS/pMMR data suggested possible improvements in disease control. Combination therapy was associated with increased odds of hypertension, hypothyroidism, hand-foot skin reaction, liver function abnormalities, and nausea; however, comparative evidence for grade ≥ 3 toxicity was insufficient because reporting was inconsistent.
CONCLUSION: Regorafenib plus PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors may improve tumor response and PFS compared with regorafenib monotherapy in refractory mCRC, but a definitive OS advantage has not been established. The MSS/pMMR findings remain exploratory and hypothesis-generating. Adequately powered, biomarker-stratified randomized trials with standardized MSI/MMR assessment, consistent safety reporting, and longer follow-up are required before this combination can be considered a standard later-line treatment.

papers.title_zh: Regorafenib 合併 PD-1/PD-L1 抑制劑治療轉移性大腸直腸癌的療效與安全性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：Regorafenib 是已核准用於轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）的後線治療。Regorafenib 合併 PD-1/PD-L1 阻斷治療，可能藉由改變腫瘤微環境而增強抗腫瘤免疫。本統合分析比較此合併療法與 regorafenib 單藥治療，並探討其在微衛星穩定／錯配修復功能正常（MSS/pMMR）mCRC 中的初步治療訊號。
方法：全面檢索 PubMed、Cochrane Library、Embase、Web of Science 及中文資料庫（萬方、維普、CNKI、CBM），搜尋截至 2026 年 2 月 20 日的文獻。納入比較合併療法與單藥治療的隨機對照試驗（RCT）及回溯性世代研究（RCS）。結果指標包括客觀反應率（ORR）、疾病控制率（DCR）、無惡化存活期（PFS）、整體存活期（OS）等。隨機試驗使用 Cochrane 偏誤風險工具評估研究品質，觀察性研究則使用 Newcastle-Ottawa Scale（NOS）。使用 RevMan 5.4 進行分析，報告風險比（RR）／風險比值（HR）及其 95% 信賴區間（CI）。以 I² 評估異質性，以漏斗圖評估發表偏誤，並於適用時進行 Egger／Begg 檢定。使用 GRADE 評定證據確定性。
結果：共納入 8 項研究（2 項 RCT、6 項 RCS；992 名病人）。相較於 regorafenib 單藥治療，合併療法提高 ORR（RR＝1.81，95% CI：1.15–2.85）、DCR（RR＝1.34，95% CI：1.10–1.62）及部分反應率（PR；RR＝1.66，95% CI：1.07–2.59），並降低腫瘤評估時疾病惡化（PD）的病人比例（RR＝0.65，95% CI：0.50–0.86）。合併療法亦與較長的 PFS 相關（HR＝0.57，95% CI：0.37–0.87）；然而，OS 的估計結果位於臨界值，未能確立穩健的存活效益（HR＝0.73，95% CI：0.54–1.00；P＝0.05）。根據可擷取的 MSS/pMMR 資料所進行的事後探索性分析，提示疾病控制可能改善。合併療法與高血壓、甲狀腺功能低下、手足皮膚反應、肝功能異常及噁心的發生勝算增加相關；但因報告方式不一致，第 3 級以上毒性的比較證據不足。
結論：相較於 regorafenib 單藥治療，regorafenib 合併 PD-1/PD-L1 抑制劑可能改善難治性 mCRC 的腫瘤反應與 PFS，但尚未確立明確的 OS 優勢。MSS/pMMR 的研究結果仍屬探索性及假說生成性質。在將此合併療法視為標準後線治療之前，仍需具足夠統計檢定力、依生物標記分層的隨機試驗，並採用標準化 MSI/MMR 評估、一致的安全性報告及更長期追蹤。

papers.title: MLH1 AND MSH2 PROTEIN EXPRESSION LOSS AND MICROSATELLITE INSTABILITY IN COLORECTAL ADENOMAS OF PATIENTS WITH LYNCH SYNDROME: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
papers.authors: Xavier G, Vaz L, Caldeira M, Tekin H, Dhaouadi T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Lynch Syndrome (LS) is a genetic condition associated with a high risk of colorectal cancer, often linked to microsatellite instability (MSI), which is caused by defects in DNA mismatch repair (MMR) genes such as MLH1 and MSH2. Although MMR deficiency and MSI are well-documented in the literature, the role of these genes in adenomas remains unclear.
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate, through meta-analysis, the correlation between loss of expression of the MLH1 and MSH2 genes and MSI in adenomas from patients with LS.
METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in the MEDLINE, SCOPUS, and Web of Science databases up to 06/09/2025, using a strategy with descriptors related to MSI, LS, and precursor lesions. Data were analyzed using the Inverse Variance method, with 95% confidence intervals. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I-squared ( I²) statistic. Outliers were identified through statistical influence diagnostics applied to each study. Publication bias was assessed using funnel plots and Egger's regression test. Statistical analyses were performed using RStudio, version 4.4.0.
RESULTS: 5 studies were included, totaling 145 adenomas from individuals with LS. A highly significant correlation was found between MSI and MSH2 expression loss (OR=13,91 [3,97-48,72]; P=0,000038; I²=0%). No significant correlation was found between MSI and loss of MLH1 expression (OR=2,19 [0,93-5,16]; P=0,073; I²=0%). Funnel plot analysis and Egger's regression test showed no significant evidence of publication bias for MLH1 (t=0.25, df=3, P-value=0.8155) or MSH2 (t=-0.79, df=3, P-value=0.4860).
CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis found a strong, significant and consistent correlation between MSI and MSH2 expression loss in adenomas, but a non-significant association for MLH1 expression loss. The lack of statistical significance in Egger's test for both genes should be interpreted with caution due to the small number of included studies (k=5). The limited literature available highlights the need for further, larger-scale research.
CONTEXTO:: A Síndrome de Lynch (SL) é uma condição genética associada a um alto risco de câncer colorretal, frequentemente ligada à instabilidade de microssatélites (IMS), que é causada por defeitos nos genes do sistema de reparo de incompatibilidade de DNA (MMR), como MLH1 e MSH2. Embora a deficiência de MMR e a IMS sejam bem documentadas na literatura, o papel desses genes em adenomas permanece incerto.
OBJETIVO:: Avaliar, por meio de meta-análise, a correlação entre a perda de expressão dos genes MLH1 e MSH2 e a IMS em adenomas de pacientes com SL.
MÉTODOS:: Uma busca sistemática foi conduzida nas bases de dados MEDLINE, SCOPUS e Web of Science até 06/09/2025, utilizando uma estratégia com descritores relacionados a IMS, SL e lesões precursoras. Os dados foram analisados utilizando o método da Variância Inversa, com intervalos de confiança de 95%. A heterogeneidade foi avaliada utilizando a estatística I-quadrado (I²). Outliers foram identificados por meio de diagnósticos de influência estatística aplicados a cada estudo. O viés de publicação foi avaliado utilizando gráficos de funil e o teste de regressão de Egger. As análises estatísticas foram realizadas utilizando o RStudio, versão 4.4.0.
RESULTADOS:: Foram incluídos 5 estudos, totalizando 145 adenomas de indivíduos com SL. Uma correlação altamente significativa foi encontrada entre IMS e perda de expressão de MSH2 (OR=13,91 [3,97-48,72]; P=0,000038; I²=0%). Nenhuma correlação significativa foi encontrada entre IMS e perda de expressão de MLH1 (OR=2,19 [0,93-5,16]; P=0,073; I²=0%). A análise do gráfico de funil e o teste de regressão de Egger não mostraram evidências significativas de viés de publicação para MLH1 (t=0,25, df=3, P-valor=0,8155) ou MSH2 (t=-0,79, df=3, P-valor=0,4860).
CONCLUSÃO:: Esta meta-análise encontrou uma correlação forte, significativa e consistente entre IMS e perda de expressão de MSH2 em adenomas, mas uma associação não significativa para a perda de expressão de MLH1. A falta de significância estatística no teste de Egger para ambos os genes deve ser interpretada com cautela devido ao pequeno número de estudos incluídos (k=5). A literatura limitada disponível destaca a necessidade de pesquisas futuras em maior escala.

papers.title_zh: Lynch症候群患者大腸直腸腺瘤中MLH1與MSH2蛋白表現缺失及微衛星不穩定性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
【英文摘要翻譯】
背景：Lynch症候群（LS）是一種與大腸直腸癌高風險相關的遺傳疾病，常與微衛星不穩定性（MSI）有關；MSI由MLH1與MSH2等DNA錯配修復（MMR）基因的缺陷所造成。雖然MMR缺陷與MSI在文獻中已有充分記載，但這些基因在腺瘤中的角色仍不明確。
目的：透過統合分析，評估LS患者腺瘤中MLH1與MSH2基因表現缺失與MSI的相關性。
方法：於MEDLINE、SCOPUS及Web of Science資料庫進行系統性搜尋，搜尋截至06/09/2025，採用與MSI、LS及前驅病灶相關的描述詞建立搜尋策略。使用反變異數法分析資料，並提供95%信賴區間。使用I平方（I²）統計量評估異質性。對各研究進行統計影響力診斷，以辨識離群值。使用漏斗圖及Egger迴歸檢定評估發表偏差。統計分析使用RStudio 4.4.0版執行。
結果：納入5篇研究，合計包含LS患者的145個腺瘤。MSI與MSH2表現缺失呈現高度統計顯著的相關性（OR=13.91［95%信賴區間3.97–48.72］；P=0.000038；I²=0%）。MSI與MLH1表現缺失未呈現統計顯著相關性（OR=2.19［95%信賴區間0.93–5.16］；P=0.073；I²=0%）。漏斗圖分析及Egger迴歸檢定顯示，MLH1（t=0.25，df=3，P值=0.8155）與MSH2（t=-0.79，df=3，P值=0.4860）均無發表偏差的顯著證據。
結論：本統合分析發現，腺瘤中的MSI與MSH2表現缺失具有強烈、顯著且一致的相關性，但與MLH1表現缺失的關聯未達統計顯著。由於納入研究數少（k=5），兩個基因的Egger檢定皆未達統計顯著，應審慎解讀。現有文獻有限，凸顯未來需要更大規模的研究。

papers.title: Gut microbial and metabolic biomarkers for early-onset colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Nofinska B, Mizutani S, Salim F, Sunakawa H, Obana N, Shiba S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Early-onset colorectal cancer (EO-CRC) is a growing global health challenge with poorly understood etiology. While gut microbiota and metabolites are implicated in colorectal carcinogenesis, EO-CRC-associated signatures remain poorly characterized. This study presents the first large-scale multi-omics analysis in Japan cohort to characterize gut microbial and metabolic features of EO-CRC, with cross-cohort validation in an independent China cohort.
RESULTS: We enrolled 510 participants (EO-CRC n = 120, late-onset CRC [LO-CRC] n = 282, young healthy controls [yHC] n = 59, old healthy controls [oHC] n = 49); after age- and sex-matching, 324 samples were analyzed using metagenomics, metabolomics, and quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). Fourteen species formed a shared CRC-associated microbiome core enriched in both EO-CRC and LO-CRC relative to age-matched controls, of which seven were reproducible across both Japan and China cohorts. Beyond this core, 34 and 21 species were enriched exclusively in EO-CRC and LO-CRC, respectively. Among EO-CRC-specific virulence findings, the bft gene of enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis, fadA of Fusobacterium nucleatum, and bai operon genes were enriched in EO-CRC, with cross-cohort validation for fadA and bai operon, and stage-specific enrichement of deoxycholic acid at Stage 0 providing preliminary metabolomic support. Targeted clbP qPCR revealed enrichment of colibactin-producing Escherichia coli specifically in EO-CRC against a background of age-increasing carriage. Metabolomic profiling identified kynurenine enrichment and depletion of vitamin B-related metabolites (pyridoxine, riboflavin, and nicotinamide) as EO-CRC-specific findings; LO-CRC showed distinct enrichment of carnitine, succinate, and spermine with relative butyrate depletion. The choline degradation pathway was enriched specifically in EO-CRC based on Enteropathway analysis. Species-based random forest classifiers distinguished EO-CRC from controls (AUPRC = 0.828; SD = 0.013; 95% CI 0.739-0.909) and generalized robustly to an independent cohort (AUPRC = 0.817; 95% CI 0.717-0.894), substantially outperforming functional gene profiles in cross-cohort settings. Within the Japan cohort, adding metabolomics provided modest additional discriminative value.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify a shared CRC microbiome core reproducible across age groups and cohorts, alongside EO-CRC-specific signatures encompassing enrichment of virulence-associated genes (bft, fadA), colibactin-producing E. coli (clbP), secondary bile acid biosynthetic genes (bai operon), and choline degradation capacity, as well as distinct metabolic perturbations including kynurenine enrichment and vitamin B-related metabolite depletion. Species-based classifiers generalize well across age groups and cohorts, with metabolomics providing complementary discriminatory value. All findings represent cross-sectional associations; longitudinal studies are needed to establish temporal ordering and evaluate clinical utility as non-invasive biomarkers for EO-CRC. papers.title_zh: 早發性大腸直腸癌的腸道微生物與代謝生物標記
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：早發性大腸直腸癌（EO-CRC）是日益嚴峻的全球健康挑戰，其病因仍未充分釐清。雖然腸道微生物相與代謝物被認為參與大腸直腸癌的致癌過程，但EO-CRC相關特徵仍缺乏充分描述。本研究首次於日本世代進行大規模多體學分析，以描繪EO-CRC的腸道微生物與代謝特徵，並於獨立中國世代進行跨世代驗證。
結果：本研究納入510名參與者，包括EO-CRC 120人、晚發性大腸直腸癌（LO-CRC）282人、年輕健康對照（yHC）59人及年長健康對照（oHC）49人；經年齡與性別配對後，以宏基因體學、代謝體學及定量聚合酶連鎖反應（qPCR）分析324份樣本。相較於年齡配對的對照組，14個菌種在EO-CRC與LO-CRC中均富集，構成共同的CRC相關微生物核心，其中7個菌種的結果可於日本與中國兩個世代重現。除了此共同核心外，另有34個與21個菌種分別僅在EO-CRC與LO-CRC中富集。在EO-CRC特異性的毒力相關發現中，產腸毒素脆弱擬桿菌（Bacteroides fragilis）的bft基因、具核梭桿菌（Fusobacterium nucleatum）的fadA基因及bai操縱子基因在EO-CRC中富集；其中fadA與bai操縱子的結果獲跨世代驗證，而第0期出現的階段特異性去氧膽酸富集，提供了初步代謝體學支持。針對clbP的標靶qPCR顯示，在帶菌率隨年齡增加的背景下，產生colibactin的大腸桿菌仍呈現EO-CRC特異性富集。代謝體分析發現，犬尿胺酸富集及維生素B相關代謝物（吡哆醇、核黃素與菸鹼醯胺）減少為EO-CRC特異性發現；LO-CRC則呈現不同的變化，包括肉鹼、琥珀酸及精胺富集，以及丁酸相對減少。Enteropathway分析顯示，膽鹼降解路徑在EO-CRC中特異性富集。以菌種為基礎的隨機森林分類器可區分EO-CRC與對照組（精確率－召回率曲線下面積［AUPRC］＝0.828；標準差［SD］＝0.013；95%信賴區間0.739–0.909），且在獨立世代中仍具穩健的泛化表現（AUPRC＝0.817；95%信賴區間0.717–0.894），在跨世代情境下明顯優於功能基因特徵。在日本世代內，加入代謝體資料可提供小幅額外的辨識價值。
結論：本研究辨識出可跨年齡層與世代重現的共同CRC微生物核心，以及EO-CRC特異性特徵，包括毒力相關基因（bft、fadA）、產生colibactin的大腸桿菌（clbP）、次級膽酸生合成基因（bai操縱子）及膽鹼降解能力的富集，並伴隨不同的代謝擾動，包括犬尿胺酸富集與維生素B相關代謝物減少。以菌種為基礎的分類器可良好泛化至不同年齡層與世代，而代謝體學可提供互補的辨識價值。所有發現均屬橫斷面關聯；仍需縱向研究建立時間先後順序，並評估其作為EO-CRC非侵入性生物標記的臨床效用。另附影片摘要。

papers.title: Mechanistic advances in neutrophil extracellular traps promoting tumor invasion via the PAR2 signaling axis
papers.abstract: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), long recognized as effectors of innate host defense, are now firmly implicated in remodeling the tumor microenvironment and facilitating tumor progression. Tumor-associated NETs expose proteases, damage-associated molecular patterns, and self-DNA that activate protease-activated receptor 2 (PAR2) on tumor and stromal cells, engaging downstream cascades (Gαq/11-PLCβ-PKC-MEK-ERK, RhoA-ROCK, β-arrestin-biased signaling, and RTK transactivation), which jointly drive epithelial-mesenchymal transition, matrix degradation, and angiogenesis, ultimately favoring invasion and metastasis. Direct evidence that NET-derived proteases engage PAR2 on tumor or stromal cells rests, however, on a limited number of studies, and much of the literature concerns NETs or PAR2 individually rather than their coupling. We searched PubMed with structured queries combining "neutrophil extracellular traps"/"NETs", "protease-activated receptor 2"/"PAR2"/"F2RL1", and cancer-related descriptors, supplemented by citation tracing, with coverage through August 2026, and graded each mechanistic claim at claim level as strong, moderate, or emerging according to explicit criteria (see Literature search and evidence grading); findings supported for NETs or PAR2 alone are labeled as such throughout. The axis is documented most completely in breast, pancreatic, lung, and colorectal cancers, where tumor-type-specific drivers have been defined (dormant-cell reawakening in breast cancer, stromal reprogramming in pancreatic cancer, bypass of targeted therapy in lung cancer, and bidirectional signaling in colorectal cancer), whereas in biliary and cervical cancers only descriptive NET data are available; therapeutic strategies targeting the axis (PAD4 inhibitors, DNase I, PAR2 antagonists/antibodies, and combinations with immune checkpoint blockade) show preclinical promise. However, validated biomarkers of pathway activity and safety data for chronic PAR2 blockade are lacking. The NETs-PAR2 axis is an emerging targetable driver of tumor invasion, and biomarker-guided, tumor-type-aware clinical development is required to translate axis-directed therapy into the clinic.

papers.abstract_zh: 嗜中性球胞外誘捕網（NETs）長期以來被視為先天性宿主防禦的效應因子，如今已有明確證據顯示，其參與腫瘤微環境重塑並促進腫瘤進展。腫瘤相關 NETs 暴露的蛋白酶、損傷相關分子模式及自身 DNA，會活化腫瘤與基質細胞上的蛋白酶活化受體 2（PAR2），啟動下游訊息傳遞級聯反應（Gαq/11-PLCβ-PKC-MEK-ERK、RhoA-ROCK、β-arrestin 偏向性訊息傳遞，以及受體酪胺酸激酶〔RTK〕轉活化），共同驅動上皮－間質轉化、基質降解與血管新生，最終有利於侵襲及轉移。然而，NETs 衍生蛋白酶作用於腫瘤或基質細胞 PAR2 的直接證據，僅來自少數研究；許多文獻探討的是 NETs 或 PAR2 各自的作用，而非兩者的耦聯。我們使用結構化檢索式搜尋 PubMed，結合「neutrophil extracellular traps」／「NETs」、「protease-activated receptor 2」／「PAR2」／「F2RL1」及癌症相關描述詞，並輔以引文追溯，文獻涵蓋至 2026 年 8 月；依據明確標準，將每項機轉論述的證據逐項分為強、中等或新興等級（見「文獻搜尋與證據分級」），且全文均標明哪些發現僅有 NETs 或 PAR2 單獨作用的證據支持。此訊息軸在乳癌、胰臟癌、肺癌及大腸直腸癌中的紀錄最為完整，並已界定各癌別特有的驅動機轉：乳癌中的休眠細胞再活化、胰臟癌中的基質重編程、肺癌中的標靶治療旁路逃脫，以及大腸直腸癌中的雙向訊息傳遞；相較之下，膽道癌與子宮頸癌目前僅有描述性的 NETs 資料。針對此訊息軸的治療策略，包括 PAD4 抑制劑、DNase I、PAR2 拮抗劑／抗體，以及與免疫檢查點阻斷治療的合併使用，均展現臨床前研究潛力。然而，目前仍缺乏經驗證的路徑活性生物標記，以及長期阻斷 PAR2 的安全性資料。NETs–PAR2 訊息軸是新興且具可標靶潛力的腫瘤侵襲驅動因子；若要將針對此訊息軸的治療轉化至臨床，仍須進行由生物標記引導、並考量癌別差異的臨床開發。

papers.title: Context-dependent functions of insulin, IGF, and GLP signaling in inflammatory bowel disease: linking metabolism, immunity, and intestinal homeostasis
papers.authors: Abuhussein E, Yamaguchi Y, Singh D, Orahovats C, Nishiyama K, Tsuboi K
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, is a chronic relapsing inflammatory disorder of the gastrointestinal tract characterized by dysregulated immune responses, impaired epithelial barrier function, and alterations in the gut microbiota. Although considerable progress has been made in understanding the immunopathogenesis of IBD, increasing evidence indicates that metabolic signaling pathways are integral regulators of intestinal inflammation, tissue repair, and disease progression. Among these, insulin, insulin-like growth factors (IGFs), and glucagon-like peptides (GLPs) constitute an interconnected immunometabolic network that links nutrient sensing, energy metabolism, epithelial regeneration, and immune homeostasis. Insulin signaling plays context-dependent roles in IBD by regulating glucose metabolism, epithelial repair, inflammatory responses, and interactions with the gut microbiota and bile acid metabolism. While insulin promotes mucosal healing and barrier restoration in intestinal epithelial cells, excessive activation of insulin signaling in immune cells may exacerbate chronic inflammation through epigenetic and cytokine-mediated mechanisms. The IGF axis is also profoundly altered during active IBD, with systemic suppression of IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 accompanying disease activity, whereas local IGF signaling promotes epithelial regeneration, wound healing, and immune regulation. In addition, IGF-binding proteins (IGFBPs) function as active modulators of inflammation, fibrosis, and colitis-associated colorectal cancer in an isoform-specific manner. GLP signaling further integrates metabolism with intestinal immunity; GLP-1 receptor agonists exhibit anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and microbiota-modulating effects, whereas GLP-2 primarily enhances epithelial proliferation, barrier integrity, and mucosal repair. Emerging preclinical and observational clinical studies suggest that GLP-based therapies may improve disease outcomes, although prospective randomized trials are still required. This review summarizes current knowledge regarding the biological functions and molecular mechanisms of insulin, IGFs, IGFBPs, and GLPs in IBD, highlighting their coordinated roles in regulating metabolism, immunity, epithelial homeostasis, and tissue remodeling. A better understanding of these interconnected signaling pathways may facilitate the development of novel immunometabolic therapeutic strategies aimed at promoting mucosal healing, limiting chronic inflammation, and improving long-term outcomes in patients with IBD.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）包括克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎，是一種慢性、反覆發作的胃腸道發炎性疾病，其特徵為免疫反應失調、上皮屏障功能受損，以及腸道微生物相改變。雖然對 IBD 免疫致病機轉的理解已有顯著進展，愈來愈多證據顯示，代謝訊號路徑是腸道發炎、組織修復與疾病進展不可或缺的調控因子。其中，胰島素、類胰島素生長因子（IGFs）與類升糖素胜肽（GLPs）構成彼此連結的免疫代謝網絡，串聯營養感知、能量代謝、上皮再生與免疫恆定。胰島素訊號透過調節葡萄糖代謝、上皮修復、發炎反應，以及與腸道微生物相和膽酸代謝的交互作用，在 IBD 中發揮依情境而異的作用。胰島素雖可促進腸上皮細胞的黏膜癒合與屏障修復，但免疫細胞中的胰島素訊號過度活化，可能透過表觀遺傳與細胞激素介導的機制，加劇慢性發炎。活動期 IBD 的 IGF 軸亦有明顯變化：全身性 IGF-1 與 IGFBP-3 的下降伴隨疾病活動，而局部 IGF 訊號則促進上皮再生、傷口癒合及免疫調節。此外，IGF 結合蛋白（IGFBPs）會依不同亞型，主動調節發炎、纖維化及結腸炎相關大腸直腸癌。GLP 訊號進一步整合代謝與腸道免疫；GLP-1 受體促效劑具有抗發炎、代謝調節及微生物相調節作用，而 GLP-2 主要增強上皮增生、屏障完整性與黏膜修復。新興的前臨床研究與觀察性臨床研究顯示，GLP 類療法可能改善疾病結果，但仍需要前瞻性隨機試驗。本綜述整理目前對胰島素、IGFs、IGFBPs 與 GLPs 在 IBD 中之生物功能及分子機轉的認識，強調其在調節代謝、免疫、上皮恆定與組織重塑方面的協同作用。更深入理解這些彼此連結的訊號路徑，可能有助於開發新的免疫代謝治療策略，以促進 IBD 病人的黏膜癒合、限制慢性發炎，並改善長期結果。

papers.title: Synergizing Short-Course Radiotherapy with Immunotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: Current Evidence, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Xu L, Jiao Y, Wei Y, Luo M
papers.abstract: The management of locally advanced rectal cancer is increasingly moving beyond a uniform cytotoxic framework toward biomarker-informed multimodal treatment. Short-course radiotherapy (SCRT) is an established and convenient radiotherapy option and may also provide an immunomodulatory context for immune checkpoint blockade. Preclinical evidence suggests that hypofractionated radiotherapy can promote immunogenic cell death and modulate the tumor immune microenvironment; however, whether the fractionation schedule of SCRT provides a clinically meaningful immunological advantage over long-course chemoradiotherapy remains uncertain. Early randomized studies of SCRT-based chemoimmunotherapy in predominantly proficient mismatch repair/microsatellite-stable (pMMR/MSS) populations have reported encouraging improvements in pathological or overall complete response rates compared with their respective control regimens. Nevertheless, differences in comparator arms, chemotherapy exposure, immunotherapy schedules, endpoint definitions, and follow-up duration preclude firm conclusions regarding the optimal radiotherapy backbone or long-term survival benefit. These findings support further prospective evaluation of SCRT-based combinations and response-adapted non-operative management in appropriately selected patients. Longitudinal circulating tumor DNA, multi-omics profiling, MR-guided adaptive radiotherapy, and computational models such as "digital twins" may contribute to improved patient selection and surveillance, but their clinical utility requires prospective validation.

papers.title: The Influence of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists on the Outcomes and Tolerability of Colorectal Cancer Therapies
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are increasingly being prescribed for metabolic diseases. At times, patients taking GLP-1RAs are also undergoing cancer treatment and surgeries, but their potential interactions with cancer therapies are not well delineated. The purpose of this narrative review is to synthesize the limited pre-clinical, translational, and the clinical evidence available, examining the biological rationale and mechanisms for GLP-1RA-cancer therapy interactions.
RECENT FINDINGS: Oncology research on GLP-1RAs has primarily focused on cancer incidence and survival, yielding generally reassuring safety data and potential outcome improvements. While emerging evidence and biological studies suggest GLP-1RAs could influence treatment tolerance and toxicity, the current clinical data remains limited, observational, and poorly integrated. However, there has been decent mechanistic research that suggests biologically plausible interactions of GLP1-RAs and cancer therapies, specifically through the AMPK and mTOR pathways. The available clinical evidence suggests that GLP-1 receptor agonist use is associated withimproved survival outcomes and reduced treatment-related complications among patients with colorectalcancer receiving chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or surgery. However, these findings are mostlyobservational, and conflicting preclinical evidence highlights the need for prospective studies to clarifythe underlying mechanisms, establish causality, and determine the clinical implications of theseinteractions.

papers.title_zh: GLP-1受體促效劑對大腸直腸癌治療結果與耐受性的影響
papers.abstract_zh:
回顧目的：升糖素樣胜肽-1受體促效劑（GLP-1RAs）愈來愈常被用於治療代謝性疾病。有時，使用GLP-1RAs的病人也同時接受癌症治療與手術，但這些藥物與癌症治療之間的潛在交互作用尚未被清楚界定。本篇敘述性綜述旨在整合目前有限的臨床前、轉譯與臨床證據，探討GLP-1RA與癌症治療交互作用的生物學依據及機轉。
近期發現：GLP-1RAs的腫瘤學研究主要聚焦於癌症發生率與存活，整體提供令人安心的安全性資料，並顯示可能改善治療結果。雖然新興證據與生物學研究顯示，GLP-1RAs可能影響治療耐受性與毒性，但目前臨床資料仍然有限，屬觀察性質，且缺乏充分整合。然而，已有相當程度的機轉研究指出，GLP-1RAs與癌症治療之間存在生物學上合理的交互作用，尤其是透過AMPK與mTOR路徑。現有臨床證據顯示，在接受化學治療、免疫治療或手術的大腸直腸癌病人中，使用GLP-1受體促效劑與較佳的存活結果及較少的治療相關併發症有關。然而，這些發現大多來自觀察性研究，而彼此矛盾的臨床前證據凸顯了前瞻性研究的必要性，以釐清其背後機轉、確立因果關係，並判定這些交互作用的臨床意涵。

papers.title: Beyond the gut: neuroinflammation as a driver of anxiety and depression in inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Bielamowicz D, Schoonover B, Sodhi K, Borthakur A
papers.abstract: Anxiety and depression frequently co-occur with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with prevalence rates substantially higher than in the general population. Emerging evidence further indicates that active IBD is associated with more severe psychological symptoms, while anxiety and depression can worsen intestinal inflammation, highlighting a bidirectional relationship. Chronic intestinal inflammation is increasingly recognized as a driver of neuroinflammation, a key mechanism underlying mood disorders. In IBD, disruption of the intestinal epithelial barrier permits metabolites and enteric signaling molecules to enter the circulation, triggering systemic inflammation and crossing the more permeable blood-brain barrier (BBB) to promote neuroinflammation. Other relevant components of the gut-brain axis contributing to IBD-associated neuroinflammation include the enteric nervous system, vagus nerve (VN), hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, and tryptophan-kynurenine metabolism. Within the brain, neuroinflammation characterized by glial activation, inflammatory mediator release, and oxidative stress disrupts neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity in regions such as the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex, contributing to anxiety and depression. Conversely, anxiety and depression can amplify systemic inflammation through dysregulation of the VN and HPA axis, thereby exacerbating IBD. This reciprocal interaction adversely affects disease severity, quality of life, and therapeutic outcomes, underscoring the need to better define its underlying mechanisms. The present review synthesizes current clinical, translational, and experimental evidence on the bidirectional crosstalk between IBD and mood disorders. We also highlight key knowledge gaps, future research directions to identify the cellular and molecular mediators of this interaction, and emerging therapeutic strategies for the integrated management of both conditions.

papers.title_zh: 不只腸道：神經發炎作為發炎性腸道疾病中焦慮與憂鬱的驅動因素
papers.abstract_zh: 焦慮與憂鬱經常與發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）共存，其盛行率明顯高於一般人口。新興證據進一步指出，活動性 IBD 與較嚴重的心理症狀相關，而焦慮與憂鬱也可能加重腸道發炎，凸顯兩者的雙向關係。慢性腸道發炎日益被認為是神經發炎的驅動因素，而神經發炎是情緒障礙的重要致病機制。在 IBD 中，腸上皮屏障受損使代謝物與腸道訊息分子得以進入循環，引發全身性發炎，並穿越通透性增加的血腦障壁（BBB），促進神經發炎。腸腦軸中其他參與 IBD 相關神經發炎的重要組成，包括腸神經系統、迷走神經（VN）、下視丘－腦下垂體－腎上腺（HPA）軸，以及色胺酸－犬尿氨酸代謝。在腦部，以神經膠細胞活化、發炎介質釋放及氧化壓力為特徵的神經發炎，會干擾海馬迴及前額葉皮質等區域的神經新生與突觸可塑性，促成焦慮與憂鬱。反過來，焦慮與憂鬱可透過 VN 與 HPA 軸失調，放大全身性發炎，進而加重 IBD。這種交互作用對疾病嚴重度、生活品質及治療結果造成不利影響，凸顯進一步釐清其背後機制的必要性。本綜述整合目前關於 IBD 與情緒障礙之間雙向交互作用的臨床、轉譯及實驗證據。我們也強調主要知識缺口、辨識此交互作用之細胞與分子介質的未來研究方向，以及整合管理這兩類疾病的新興治療策略。

papers.title: Beyond the LARS score: functional burden does not necessarily equal psychological burden
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Ammer et al. reported no significant difference in low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) between open and robotic rectal cancer surgery. This commentary addresses the interindividual variability in LARS outcomes.
METHODS: This conceptual commentary critically reviews the outcome assessment strategy used in the original study and integrates supporting evidence from the psycho-oncology literature.
RESULTS: Functional burden, as captured by the LARS score, does not necessarily equal psychological burden. Psychological adaptation-resilience, coping style, distress, and illness perception-is hypothesised to mediate the relationship between functional impairment and patient-reported quality of life.
CONCLUSION: Functional burden and psychological burden are related but distinct constructs. Future studies should test mediation and moderation models to determine whether psychological adaptation explains the variability between LARS severity and quality of life.

papers.title: Microbiota-driven of chromosomal instability in colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the third most common malignancy worldwide and the second leading cause of cancer-related death, and chromosomal instability (CIN) underlies 65-70% of sporadic cases. Here we review the evidence that the gut microbiota acts as an environmental instigator of CIN through three mechanistically intertwined routes. The first is direct genotoxicity: pks+ Escherichia coli produce colibactin, which alkylates deoxyadenosine to form DNA interstrand cross-links whose repair generates double-strand break intermediates and the mutational signatures SBS88 and ID18; transient exposure of primary colon epithelial cells suffices to provoke chromosomal aberrations and malignant transformation. The second is community-level dysbiosis: the oncomicrobial community subtypes OCS2 and OCS3 are enriched in CIN-positive tumours and carry the reactive oxygen species-related signature SBS18, while at strain-level resolution Fusobacterium nucleatum subspecies animalis clade C2 shows the strongest association with the tumour niche, and Parvimonas micra and Peptostreptococcus stomatis contribute through WNT/β-catenin activation and Th17-skewed immunity. The third, advanced here as a working framework rather than an established mechanism, is the microbiota-induced bystander effect (MIBE), in which microbiota-driven para-inflammation creates a milieu rich in reactive oxygen and nitrogen species and inflammatory cytokines that damages DNA in neighbouring epithelial cells and establishes a field of cancerization. We integrate these routes into a three-stage model (initiation, propagation, perpetuation) linking microbial exposure to APC, KRAS and TP53 alterations, discuss translation towards risk stratification, faecal metagenomic diagnosis, OCS-based prognostication and targeted prevention, and delineate the limitations of the current evidence.
papers.title_zh: 腸道微生物相驅動的大腸直腸癌染色體不穩定性
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球第三常見的惡性腫瘤，也是癌症相關死亡的第二大原因，而染色體不穩定性（CIN）是65–70%散發性病例的致病基礎。本文回顧腸道微生物相透過三條機制上相互交織的路徑，成為CIN之環境誘發因子的證據。第一條路徑是直接基因毒性：pks+大腸桿菌產生colibactin，將去氧腺苷烷基化，形成DNA股間交聯；修復這些交聯時會產生雙股斷裂中間產物，以及SBS88與ID18突變特徵；原代結腸上皮細胞僅需短暫暴露，即足以引發染色體異常與惡性轉化。第二條路徑是菌群層級的菌相失衡：致癌微生物群亞型OCS2與OCS3在CIN陽性腫瘤中富集，且帶有與活性氧物種相關的SBS18突變特徵；在菌株層級的解析下，具核梭桿菌動物亞種（Fusobacterium nucleatum subspecies animalis）的C2支系與腫瘤生態棲位的關聯最強，而微小微單胞菌（Parvimonas micra）與胃消化鏈球菌（Peptostreptococcus stomatis）則透過WNT/β-catenin活化及偏向Th17的免疫反應參與其中。第三條路徑是微生物相誘發的旁觀者效應（MIBE）；本文將其提出為工作架構，而非已確立的機制。在此架構中，微生物相驅動的類發炎反應，形成富含活性氧與活性氮物種及發炎細胞激素的微環境，損傷鄰近上皮細胞的DNA，並建立癌化場域。我們將這些路徑整合為三階段模型（起始、傳播、持續），連結微生物暴露與APC、KRAS及TP53的變異，討論其朝向風險分層、糞便宏基因體診斷、以OCS為基礎的預後評估及標靶預防之轉譯應用，並闡明目前證據的限制。

papers.title: Colonoscopy surveillance after colorectal cancer surgery: meta-analysis
papers.authors: Panula J, Hokkanen K, Seppälä T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Colonoscopy surveillance is recommended following colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery, yet the evidence supporting the recommendations has major quality issues. This study assessed the independent impact of colonoscopy surveillance within 5 years after CRC surgery.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted. Medline, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception until 18 June 2026 for randomized clinical trials comparing follow-up protocols including colonoscopy surveillance (intervention) to those without colonoscopy surveillance (control) within 5 years after CRC surgery. Risk of bias was assessed using the RoB 2 tool. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted to estimate the strength of associations with recurrence detection, reoperation rate, and survival. The number needed to scope (NNS) to detect one recurrence and health economic considerations were estimated. The study protocol has been registered in PROSPERO.
RESULTS: Of 4381 records, five trials with 2337 patients were included. Four trials enrolled patients between 1983 and 1994, predating subsequent advances in CRC treatment. All trials used additional surveillance modalities, leading to a high risk of bias. Follow-up protocols with colonoscopy were not associated with recurrence profile, with risk ratios (RRs) of 0.74 (95% confidence interval (c.i.) 0.32 to 1.69), 1.23 (95% c.i. 0.93 to 1.63), and 0.93 (95% c.i. 0.76 to 1.14) for intraluminal, locoregional, and distant recurrence, respectively. Colonoscopy during follow-up was associated with a higher rate of asymptomatic recurrence (RR 2.38; 95% c.i. 1.53 to 3.69). More curative-intent reoperations were performed in the intervention than control group (RR 1.66; 95% c.i. 1.16 to 2.37), but this was not translated into improved survival (hazard ratio 0.92; 95% c.i. 0.77 to 1.11). The NNS was 159 (95% c.i. 101 to 267), resulting in estimated cost per colonoscopy-detected recurrence of €104 100 (95% c.i. €66 200 to 174 900).
CONCLUSION: Current evidence from randomized trials does not clearly demonstrate that postoperative colonoscopy surveillance improves survival, although interpretation is limited by the age of the trials and confounding from concurrent surveillance modalities. Contemporary randomized trials are required to better define the independent contribution of colonoscopy within modern multimodal surveillance pathways.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌術後大腸鏡追蹤：統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸癌（CRC）術後建議接受大腸鏡追蹤，但支持這些建議的證據存在重大品質問題。本研究評估CRC術後5年內大腸鏡追蹤的獨立影響。
方法：進行系統性回顧與統合分析。搜尋Medline、Scopus、Web of Science及Cochrane隨機對照試驗中央登錄資料庫，自各資料庫建置起至2026年6月18日，納入比較CRC術後5年內含大腸鏡追蹤之追蹤方案（介入組）與不含大腸鏡追蹤之方案（對照組）的隨機臨床試驗。使用RoB 2工具評估偏誤風險。採隨機效應統合分析，估計與復發偵測、再次手術率及存活的關聯強度。另估算每偵測一例復發所需的大腸鏡檢查次數（NNS），並評估健康經濟相關考量。研究計畫已於PROSPERO註冊。
結果：在4,381筆紀錄中，納入5項試驗，共2,337名病人。其中4項試驗於1983至1994年間收案，早於其後CRC治療的進展。所有試驗均使用其他追蹤方式，導致偏誤風險偏高。含大腸鏡的追蹤方案與復發型態無明確關聯：腸腔內、局部區域及遠端復發的風險比（RR）分別為0.74（95%信賴區間0.32至1.69）、1.23（95%信賴區間0.93至1.63）及0.93（95%信賴區間0.76至1.14）。追蹤期間接受大腸鏡檢查與較高的無症狀復發偵測率相關（RR 2.38；95%信賴區間1.53至3.69）。介入組接受根治意圖再次手術的比率高於對照組（RR 1.66；95%信賴區間1.16至2.37），但未轉化為存活改善（危險比0.92；95%信賴區間0.77至1.11）。NNS為159（95%信賴區間101至267），據此估計每透過大腸鏡偵測一例復發的成本為104,100歐元（95%信賴區間66,200至174,900歐元）。
結論：目前隨機試驗證據未能明確證實術後大腸鏡追蹤可改善存活；然而，試驗年代久遠及同時使用其他追蹤方式所造成的混雜，限制了結果的解讀。需要當代隨機試驗，進一步界定大腸鏡在現代多模式追蹤流程中的獨立貢獻。

papers.title: Adjuvant mFOLFOXIRI after curative-intent resection of oligometastatic colorectal cancer: phase II FANTASTIC trial
papers.ptype: Clinical Trial, Phase II, Multicenter Study
papers.authors: Kataoka K, Yamada T, Yamazaki K, Kanaka S, Suto T, Shiozawa M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with oligometastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) remain at high risk of recurrence after curative surgery, yet the benefit of adjuvant chemotherapy remains inconclusive. This study evaluated the feasibility and efficacy of adjuvant modified (m)FOLFOXIRI (irinotecan, oxaliplatin, L-leucovorin (L-LV), 5-fluorouracil (5-FU)), as well as the utility of circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) as a prognostic and predictive biomarker in mCRC.
METHODS: Between October 2020 and January 2024, patients with histologically confirmed mCRC undergoing complete metastasectomy were enrolled in this multicentre non-randomized phase II study. Eligible and consenting patients received eight cycles of mFOLFOXIRI followed by four cycles of 5-FU/L-LV; ineligible/non-consenting patients received standard of care (SOC; CAPOX (capecitabine and oxaliplatin), 5-FU, or observation). ctDNA was assessed using the tumour-informed personalized Signatera™ assay (Natera, Austin, TX, USA) at 28 days and 7 months after surgery. The primary endpoint was completion of eight cycles of mFOLFOXIRI in a target sample of 36 patients.
RESULTS: Of the 83 registered patients, 73 were enrolled (39 mFOLFOXIRI, 34 SOC). The mFOLFOXIRI completion rate was 74% (80% confidence interval 63% to 83%; P < 0.001). ctDNA positivity predicted significantly inferior recurrence-free survival across both the mFOLFOXIRI and SOC treatment groups at 28 days (hazard ratios (HR) 7.27 and 7.17, respectively) and 7 months (HR 3.96 and 4.38, respectively) after surgery. Multivariate analysis identified ctDNA positivity, RAS mutation, metachronous metastases, and mFOLFOXIRI as significant prognostic factors. mFOLFOXIRI improved recurrence-free survival compared with SOC in the overall population (HR 0.44; P = 0.012), with a trend towards benefit in ctDNA-positive but not ctDNA-negative patients. ctDNA clearance rates were 33% (mFOLFOXIRI) and 20% (SOC).
CONCLUSIONS: This study indicates the feasibility of adjuvant mFOLFOXIRI in patients with mCRC, with an acceptable safety profile and potential clinical benefit among those with ctDNA positivity 28 days after surgery.

papers.title_zh: 寡轉移大腸直腸癌以治癒為目的切除後的輔助性mFOLFOXIRI：第二期FANTASTIC試驗
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：寡轉移大腸直腸癌（mCRC）病人在根治性手術後仍有高度復發風險，但輔助化學治療的效益尚無定論。本研究評估輔助性改良型（m）FOLFOXIRI（irinotecan、oxaliplatin、L-leucovorin〔L-LV〕、5-fluorouracil〔5-FU〕）的可行性與療效，以及循環腫瘤DNA（ctDNA）作為mCRC預後與治療效果預測生物標記的效用。
方法：本多中心、非隨機第二期研究於2020年10月至2024年1月間，納入經組織學確認為mCRC且接受完整轉移病灶切除的病人。符合資格且同意的病人接受8個療程mFOLFOXIRI，接續4個療程5-FU/L-LV；不符合資格或不同意者接受標準照護（SOC；CAPOX〔capecitabine與oxaliplatin〕、5-FU或觀察）。於術後28天及7個月，使用依據個別腫瘤資訊設計的個人化Signatera™檢測（Natera，美國德州奧斯汀）評估ctDNA。主要終點為完成8個療程mFOLFOXIRI，目標樣本數為36名病人。
結果：83名登錄病人中，73名納入研究（mFOLFOXIRI組39名、SOC組34名）。mFOLFOXIRI完成率為74%（80%信賴區間63%至83%；P < 0.001）。在mFOLFOXIRI與SOC兩組中，術後28天ctDNA陽性均預示顯著較差的無復發存活（風險比〔HR〕分別為7.27與7.17），術後7個月亦然（HR分別為3.96與4.38）。多變項分析顯示，ctDNA陽性、RAS突變、異時性轉移及mFOLFOXIRI為顯著預後因子。在整體族群中，相較於SOC，mFOLFOXIRI改善無復發存活（HR 0.44；P = 0.012）；ctDNA陽性病人呈現獲益趨勢，ctDNA陰性病人則未呈現此趨勢。ctDNA清除率在mFOLFOXIRI組為33%，SOC組為20%。
結論：本研究顯示，對mCRC病人施行輔助性mFOLFOXIRI具有可行性，安全性可接受，且對術後28天ctDNA陽性的病人可能具有臨床效益。

papers.title: Long-term outcomes after total colonic aganglionosis: retrospective European multicentre cohort study
papers.authors: Mutanen A, Pini Prato A, Erculiani M, Lambe C, Lindert J, Märzheuser S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Total colon aganglionosis (TCA), a severe form of Hirschsprung disease, is a rare and complex condition with variable management and limited outcome data. This retrospective cross-sectional multicentre study assessed current long-term outcomes of TCA in Europe.
METHODS: Patients with TCA under follow up at participating ERNICA and ESPGHAN centres were included. Data were collected on genetics, nutritional, functional, and surgical outcomes, intestinal inflammatory lesions, and mortality during the preceding 10 years.
RESULTS: Thirty-one centres from 15 countries contributed 401 patients (median age 7.9 years; interquartile range 4.0-13.6 years). Genetic testing was performed in 52% of patients, with pathogenic variants identified in 62%, mainly RET. Aganglionosis was limited to the colon in 26%, extended to the small bowel in 71%, and was total intestinal in 3%, without association with genetic status. At the latest follow-up, 25% of patients were receiving parenteral nutrition (PN); PN dependency was associated with small intestine extension of aganglionosis > 50 cm (72% of patients with >50 cm small bowel aganglionosis versus 15% of patients aganglionosis <50 cm small bowel or limited to the colon; P < 0.001). Overall, 77% of patients underwent pull-through, most commonly ileoanal anastomosis (62%) or Duhamel (31%). Complications included anastomotic leak (4%), strictures (12%), redo surgery (24%), recurrent enterocolitis (36%), obstructive symptoms (24%), and faecal incontinence (25%). Recurrent enterocolitis was associated with obstructive symptoms (P = 0.007). Endoscopy showed intestinal inflammatory lesions in 22% of patients, particularly those with recurrent enterocolitis (odds ratio (OR) 6.43; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 3.27 to 12.63) and obstructive symptoms (OR 2.64; 95% c.i. 1.26 to 5.53). The 10-year mortality rate was 3.4%.
CONCLUSION: TCA shows a high prevalence of genetic abnormalities and substantial postoperative and long-term morbidity, independent of surgical technique.
papers.title_zh: 全結腸無神經節症的長期結果：歐洲多中心回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：全結腸無神經節症（TCA）是先天性巨結腸症的嚴重類型，屬於罕見且複雜的疾病，處置方式不一，且結果資料有限。本回溯性橫斷面多中心研究評估歐洲TCA目前的長期結果。
方法：納入於參與研究的ERNICA及ESPGHAN中心接受追蹤的TCA病人。收集遺傳、營養、功能與手術結果、腸道發炎病灶，以及過去10年間的死亡資料。
結果：來自15個國家的31個中心提供401名病人的資料（年齡中位數7.9歲；四分位距4.0–13.6歲）。52%的病人接受基因檢測，其中62%發現致病性變異，主要為RET。無神經節範圍在26%的病人僅限於結腸，71%延伸至小腸，3%累及全腸道，且與遺傳狀態無關。最近一次追蹤時，25%的病人接受靜脈營養（PN）；PN依賴與小腸無神經節範圍超過50公分有關（小腸無神經節範圍＞50公分者為72%，相較於小腸無神經節範圍＜50公分或僅限結腸者的15%；P＜0.001）。整體而言，77%的病人接受腸道拉下手術，最常見術式為迴腸肛門吻合術（62%）或Duhamel術式（31%）。併發症包括吻合口滲漏（4%）、狹窄（12%）、再次手術（24%）、反覆腸炎（36%）、阻塞症狀（24%）及糞便失禁（25%）。反覆腸炎與阻塞症狀有關（P＝0.007）。內視鏡顯示22%的病人有腸道發炎病灶，尤其見於反覆腸炎者（勝算比〔OR〕6.43；95%信賴區間3.27–12.63）及有阻塞症狀者（OR 2.64；95%信賴區間1.26–5.53）。10年死亡率為3.4%。
結論：TCA的基因異常盛行率高，且術後及長期病況負擔顯著，不受手術術式影響。

papers.title: Context-dependent cGAS-STING signaling in inflammatory bowel disease: cell specificity, lesion state, and therapeutic windows
papers.authors: Bian H, Jin W, Chen Y, Su L, Zhang R
papers.abstract: Whether cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) signaling should be inhibited in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) cannot be answered from pathway abundance alone. Canonical ER-Golgi-TBK1-IRF3/NF-κB signaling can amplify intestinal inflammation, whereas nuclear STING-AHR signaling, T-cell-intrinsic STING, ILC3 sensing, and epithelial antimicrobial programs may support microbial tolerance, host defense, or repair. We therefore examine STING output across subcellular location, signal source and duration, responding cell type, lesion state, and strength of evidence. The most consistent pathogenic evidence comes from experimental colitis with sustained DNA exposure and myeloid or epithelial stress; direct human evidence is more limited, mainly cross-sectional, and heterogeneous between ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease. This distinction limits inferences from increased cGAS/STING expression or interferon-stimulated genes, which do not establish cGAMP production, STING trafficking or phosphorylation, TBK1-IRF3 activation, or a causal biological outcome. The available data support a working model rather than a validated temporal sequence: protective and pathogenic programs can coexist within the same lesion, and broad systemic inhibition may impair antimicrobial defense, tolerance, mucosal repair, or tumor immune surveillance. Translation will therefore require cell-resolved target-engagement biomarkers and locally delivered, time-limited interventions tested in longitudinal human tissue and models that preserve microbiota and lesion heterogeneity.

papers.abstract_zh: 在發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中，是否應抑制環狀 GMP-AMP 合成酶（cGAS）－干擾素基因刺激蛋白（STING）訊號，無法僅憑路徑相關分子的豐度作答。典型的內質網（ER）－高基氏體－TBK1－IRF3/NF-κB 訊號可放大腸道發炎；相對地，細胞核內的 STING-AHR 訊號、T 細胞內在的 STING、第三型先天淋巴細胞（ILC3）的感知作用，以及上皮細胞的抗微生物反應程序，可能有助於對微生物的耐受、宿主防禦或修復。因此，我們從次細胞位置、訊號來源與持續時間、反應細胞類型、病灶狀態及證據強度等面向，檢視 STING 的下游作用。最一致的致病性證據來自具有持續性 DNA 暴露，以及髓系細胞或上皮細胞壓力的實驗性結腸炎；直接的人體證據較有限，主要為橫斷面研究，且在潰瘍性結腸炎與克隆氏症之間存在異質性。這項區別限制了由 cGAS/STING 表現增加或干擾素刺激基因增加所能做出的推論，因為這些變化並不能證實 cGAMP 生成、STING 的細胞內運輸或磷酸化、TBK1-IRF3 活化，或具有因果關係的生物學結果。現有資料支持的是一個工作模型，而非經驗證的時間序列：保護性與致病性反應程序可以共存於同一病灶，而廣泛的全身性抑制可能損害抗微生物防禦、耐受、黏膜修復或腫瘤免疫監視。因此，臨床轉譯將需要能區分細胞類型的標的作用生物標記，以及局部給藥、限時介入的策略，並在縱向採集的人體組織及保留微生物相與病灶異質性的模型中進行測試。

papers.title: Eosinophils in autoimmune diseases: context-dependent pathogenesis, functional heterogeneity, and therapeutic translation
papers.authors: Fan Z, Zhu W, Huang N, Yu H
papers.abstract: Eosinophils are best known for their host defence against helminths and for their effector role in type 2 inflammation, but an expanding evidence base indicates that their functions extend to immune regulation, tissue repair, fibrosis, and selected autoimmune phenotypes. This narrative review critically evaluates eosinophil biology across inflammatory arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody-associated vasculitis (AAV), autoimmune neurological and endocrine disorders, autoimmune dermatoses, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and fibrosing connective-tissue disorders. We organize the evidence around four recurring processes: tissue recruitment and niche imprinting, degranulation and eosinophil extracellular trap formation, cross talk with innate and adaptive immune cells, and context-dependent repair or fibrotic remodelling. The strength of evidence is highly disease dependent. Human mechanistic and interventional data are strongest in eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) and selected eosinophil-rich dermatoses, whereas many proposed roles in RA, SLE, central nervous system autoimmunity, endocrinopathies, and IBD remain observational or preclinical. Proposed resident/regulatory and inflammatory eosinophil states support functional plasticity, but several frequently used marker schemes derive predominantly from mouse studies and do not yet constitute a standardized human taxonomy. Therapeutically, IL-5/IL-5Rα blockade provides clinically validated benefit in EGPA, but efficacy should not be extrapolated across autoimmune diseases without phenotype-specific evidence. Transient blood eosinophilia and rare eosinophilic complications during IL-4Rα blockade are clinically recognized; however, compensatory IL-5 signaling, altered trafficking, and unmasking of pre-existing eosinophilic disease remain competing, incompletely resolved explanations. Across the field, causal inference is constrained by species differences, limited access to representative human tissue, heterogeneous biomarker definitions, and a scarcity of controlled trials. Eosinophils should therefore be viewed not as universal drivers of autoimmunity but as context-dependent immune modulators whose pathogenic or protective contribution varies by tissue, disease stage, and cellular state. Human tissue-resolved studies and phenotype-guided trials will be essential for translating this heterogeneity into precision therapy.

papers.title_zh: 嗜酸性球在自體免疫疾病中的角色：情境依賴的致病機轉、功能異質性與治療轉譯
papers.abstract_zh: 嗜酸性球最廣為人知的功能，是對抗蠕蟲的宿主防禦作用，以及在第2型發炎中扮演效應細胞的角色；但日益增加的證據顯示，其功能也涵蓋免疫調節、組織修復、纖維化及特定自體免疫表型。本敘述性綜述批判性地評估嗜酸性球在發炎性關節炎、全身性紅斑性狼瘡（SLE）、抗嗜中性球細胞質抗體相關血管炎（AAV）、自體免疫性神經與內分泌疾病、自體免疫性皮膚病、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），以及纖維化性結締組織疾病中的生物學。我們依四項反覆出現的過程整理證據：組織募集與微環境印記、脫顆粒與嗜酸性球胞外陷阱形成、與先天及適應性免疫細胞的交互作用，以及情境依賴的修復或纖維化重塑。證據強度高度取決於疾病種類。人體機轉與介入研究的證據，以嗜酸性肉芽腫性多發性血管炎（EGPA）及部分富含嗜酸性球的皮膚病最為充分；相較之下，嗜酸性球在類風濕性關節炎（RA）、SLE、中樞神經系統自體免疫、內分泌疾病及IBD中的許多推定作用，仍停留在觀察性或臨床前研究階段。所提出的組織駐留／調節型及發炎型嗜酸性球狀態，支持其具有功能可塑性；然而，數種常用標記分類方案主要源自小鼠研究，尚未構成標準化的人類分類系統。治療方面，阻斷IL-5／IL-5Rα在EGPA已有經臨床驗證的效益，但若缺乏特定表型的證據，不應將療效外推至其他自體免疫疾病。臨床上已知，阻斷IL-4Rα期間可能出現暫時性周邊血嗜酸性球增多及罕見的嗜酸性球相關併發症；然而，代償性IL-5訊號傳遞、細胞遷移改變，以及原先已存在的嗜酸性球疾病顯現，仍是彼此競爭且尚未完全釐清的解釋。整體而言，物種差異、難以取得具代表性的人體組織、生物標記定義不一，以及對照試驗不足，均限制了因果推論。因此，不應將嗜酸性球視為自體免疫的普遍驅動因子，而應視為情境依賴的免疫調節者，其致病或保護作用會隨組織、疾病階段及細胞狀態而異。具組織解析度的人體研究與依表型引導的試驗，將是把這種異質性轉譯為精準治療的必要條件。

papers.title: Anorectal manometry after rectal cancer surgery: physiological insights, clinical interpretation, and limitations
papers.abstract: Anorectal manometry (ARM) provides objective physiological information on anal sphincter function, rectal or neorectal sensation, reservoir capacity, and anorectal reflexes after rectal cancer surgery. In rectal cancer surgery, ARM has been used to evaluate functional changes after sphincter-preserving procedures, reconstruction with colonic J-pouch, neoadjuvant radiotherapy, and postoperative bowel dysfunction, including low anterior resection syndrome (LARS). This review summarizes the clinical applications of ARM in rectal cancer surgery, with emphasis on historical and contemporary manometric parameters, their relationship with patient-reported outcomes, and their limitations in postoperative functional assessment. Although several studies have reported associations between manometric findings and bowel dysfunction, the clinical interpretation of ARM remains limited by heterogeneity in measurement protocols, equipment dependency, timing of assessment, and variable correlation with quality-of-life measures. Recent advances, including high-resolution manometry and standardized testing protocols, may improve the reliability and clinical utility of ARM. ARM may provide adjunctive physiological information in selected patients and research settings, but current evidence does not support its use as a stand-alone diagnostic test for LARS or as a routine treatment-decision tool.

papers.abstract_zh: 肛門直腸壓力檢查（ARM）可在直腸癌手術後，提供有關肛門括約肌功能、直腸或新直腸感覺、儲存容量及肛門直腸反射的客觀生理資訊。在直腸癌手術中，ARM已被用來評估括約肌保留手術、結腸J型囊袋重建、新輔助放射治療後的功能變化，以及包括低前位切除症候群（LARS）在內的術後腸道功能障礙。本篇綜述整理ARM在直腸癌手術中的臨床應用，著重於過去與當代的壓力測量參數、這些參數與病人自述結果的關係，以及其在術後功能評估上的限制。雖然數項研究曾報告壓力測量結果與腸道功能障礙之間存在關聯，但ARM的臨床判讀仍受限於測量流程的異質性、對設備的依賴、評估時點，以及與生活品質指標之間不一致的相關性。近期進展，包括高解析度壓力檢查與標準化檢測流程，可能改善ARM的可靠性與臨床效用。ARM可在經選擇的病人及研究情境中提供輔助性生理資訊，但目前證據不支持將其作為LARS的單獨診斷檢查，或常規治療決策工具。

papers.title: Host Fitness in Gastrointestinal Oncology: Beyond Tumor Biology
papers.authors: Sun G, Du X, Zhang X, Wang H, Jiao Y, Zhang B
papers.abstract: Patients with gastrointestinal cancers face site-specific threats to nutritional intake, muscle function, organ reserve, and recovery. This critical narrative review examines host fitness as an organizing concept for these vulnerabilities rather than as a validated composite score. A targeted PubMed update identified publications from 2022 through September 14, 2026, using gastrointestinal cancer terms combined with prehabilitation, microbiome-immunotherapy, geriatric assessment, exercise, and digital assessment terms, while retaining relevant foundational studies. The review distinguishes guideline-supported care from prognostic associations and research-stage applications. Geriatric and nutritional assessments can guide established supportive care, whereas computed tomography-derived body composition and inflammatory indices primarily provide prognostic information. Microbiome signatures, epigenetic clocks, and integrated digital models require further validation before they can guide treatment decisions. Intervention effects vary by tumor site and treatment phase: selected prehabilitation trials demonstrate short-term benefits, although findings remain inconsistent, while long-term exercise after adjuvant chemotherapy for colon cancer represents a distinct evidence base. An operational assessment protocol and multidisciplinary workflow are presented to link documented impairments with existing care pathways and repeated assessment. No host-fitness threshold is proposed for treatment escalation, de-escalation, or sequencing. Prospective studies should establish incremental predictive value and patient benefit beyond existing assessments before this integrated framework is used to support precision treatment decisions.

papers.title_zh: 胃腸道腫瘤學中的宿主適能：超越腫瘤生物學
papers.abstract_zh: 胃腸道癌症病人在營養攝取、肌肉功能、器官儲備與恢復方面，面臨因腫瘤部位而異的威脅。本批判性敘事回顧將宿主適能視為整合這些脆弱性的概念，而非經驗證的複合評分。研究以胃腸道癌症相關詞彙，結合術前強化、微生物相與免疫治療、老年評估、運動及數位評估相關詞彙，進行針對性的 PubMed 文獻更新，辨識出2022年至2026年9月14日發表的文獻，並保留相關的奠基性研究。本回顧區分了指引支持的照護、預後相關性，以及仍處研究階段的應用。老年與營養評估可引導既有的支持性照護，而由電腦斷層影像衍生的身體組成與發炎指標，主要提供預後資訊。微生物相特徵、表觀遺傳時鐘及整合式數位模型，在能夠引導治療決策之前，仍需進一步驗證。介入效果因腫瘤部位與治療階段而異：部分術前強化試驗顯示短期效益，但研究結果仍不一致；至於結腸癌輔助化學治療後的長期運動，則屬於另一套獨立的證據基礎。本文提出可操作的評估流程與多專業團隊工作流程，將已記錄的功能缺損連結至既有照護路徑及重複評估。本文未提出任何用於治療升階、降階或治療順序安排的宿主適能閾值。在運用此整合架構支持精準治療決策之前，前瞻性研究應先確立其相較於既有評估所增加的預測價值，以及對病人的實際效益。
